value.title: PRD 005 procedures build: ddocs, template and gate traps

sections.name: body
sections.value:
PRD 005 (procedures) build, branch docs/prd-005-procedures, worktree ../docs-prd-005-procedures. Traps hit, in order:

- ddocs address segments must start with a letter: step ids are `s0001`, not `0001` (a `requires` link to `#steps/0003` is E405). The runner accepts `0001` as shorthand.
- ddocs has no `boolean` type: it validates, but `ddocs build --check` reports "adapter-not-found" and ddocs-check fails. Use an enum (`yes_no`).
- `ddocs set` needs `--value-json` for arrays (E453); a script that ignores ddocs' JSON status hides that.
- The role templates are compiled into the daemon (`crates/daemon/src/community/templates.rs`: SHIPPED and PINNED sha256 rows). A new template version also has to update `crates/daemon/tests/templates_http/mod.rs`, which pins coder's version list.
- `crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs` checks every `pij …` command printed in a template packet against pij-rs's native verbs; shim-local verbs (fleet-map, proc) are now allowed through SHIM_LOCAL_VERBS.
- `.omp/extensions/pij/core/message.test.ts` bans the legacy frame-head literal anywhere in skills/pij; build such a string from parts.
- Biome can't parse a top-level `return` in a .cjs file (node accepts it): wrap the branches in functions.
- Cargo stops at the first failing test binary: after fixing one, rerun all of `just rust-check`. Keep the full log in a file; `| cut` hid the failure once.
- Run your own procedure for real before calling it done: a fresh-repo run found five runner bugs that the unit tests missed (skill-home detection, EPIPE on `| head`, among others).
